Below the screen is a dark brown casing containing a navigation cluster with multiple buttons (directional pad and function keys). The device has rounded edges and appears to be made of plastic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible and distorted. While it mimics the layout of words and headers, the characters themselves are nonsensical glyphs or blurred blobs, a common AI artifact when rendering specific UI text.

The buttons below the screen lack clear mechanical definition. They appear to melt into the casing rather than sitting as distinct, pressable components. The holes/indentations are irregular and do not follow a logical ergonomic pattern for a directional pad.
The white frame around the screen has a slightly uneven, soft texture rather than the sharp, clean edge expected of molded plastic or glass assembly.
